scenes.text: *Oxford University* was already teaching students before the *Aztec Empire* existed.
Teaching at Oxford started around *1096 AD.* The Aztecs didn't found Tenochtitlan until *1325.*
So when the Aztec Empire *rose and fell,* Oxford had already been running for centuries.
It gets stranger: Oxford is also older than the *Inca Empire,* and older than the *Ottoman Empire.*
We picture 'ancient' and 'modern' as far apart. Timelines like this say *otherwise.*
History doesn't move in neat rows — *it overlaps* far more than we think.
Follow for more *lost secrets* of history.
